newsitem.title: JAPAN: SANKYO SHARES FALL ON PROFIT TAKING.
newsitem.headline: SANKYO SHARES FALL ON PROFIT TAKING.

text.p: Shares in Sankyo Co Ltd fell sharply on Wednesday morning on the Tokyo Stock Exchange due to profit taking, traders said.
By 0128 GMT, shares of the pharmaceutical maker were down 110 yen at 4,130 yen on the first section of the bourse.
Foreign traders such as Merril Lynch, Lehman Brothers and Morgan Stanley are among the main sellers of Sankyo shares, dealers said.
"There are no fresh selling factors in particular, but market participants are few, and shares are being pushed down by small-lot profit taking," a foreign trader said.
